call risk score with alerts and optional blocking, an outbound SIP trunk for a customer's own dialler, the owner's Approve or Decline on held snags, and fixes for late-read email and ticket links.

Call risk score: every outbound call now gets a 0–100 fraud score on top of the call risk rules, from a new country for the tenant, a cost per minute well above usual, bursts of short answered calls, after-hours spikes and the caller ID's reputation. At 50 or more the call goes ahead and voice admins are alerted in working hours. A tenant can turn blocking on: then a broken call risk rule or a score of 80 or more stops the call and alerts at once. Blocking is off by default. Alerts come at most once of each kind every 30 minutes, every blocked call is in the audit log, and the score shows in the call records.

Call Control trunk: a tenant with Call Control can point its own dialler at an outbound SIP trunk on the platform. Its calls go out through our carriers with the tenant's caller-ID pool, the campaign's caller-ID rewrite rules, do-not-call lists, AMD, optional recording and conversation analytics, and a calls-per-second cap. Every trunk call is checked against the call risk rules, and a call that breaks them is refused. The trunk's call records can be read through the API for billing and integrations.

Snag decisions: a snag can be held for the owner's decision and is listed first with a "Needs your decision" badge. The owner can Approve it, with optional instructions, or Decline it with a reason that is emailed to the reporter.

Fixes: email read more than 14 days after it arrived no longer drops out of "Why was no reply sent?". Ticket emails show link names instead of the long link text after them. In Workforce Plan, an "All queues" forecast now runs the forecast for each queue.

For operators: media nodes now mark the calls they send through the edge, and the edge logs any call without the mark (log mode, nothing is refused yet). The trunk's calls-per-second cap is enforced on the platform; the edge's own per-trunk cap is not in this release, because it needs an edge restart."}
